c74object.name: evi_pan_mono
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Pan audio signals, mono
c74object.description:
evi_pan_mono is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_pan_mono.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_utilities.genexpr
Pan input to outputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. evi_pan_mono is available in MSP as evi.pan~.

geninlet.name: mono
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be panned

geninlet.name: panning
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.5. Pan Amount 0..1, Pan input to outputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. 0.5 = center.
